title: chat.completions compatibility: more deterministic streaming frames, stop+tool handoff, per-token logprobs and structured message shaping
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds improved OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: deterministic streaming frame ordering and ACK semantics, coordinated stop token enforcement that cooperates with function/tool calling, optional per-token logprobs surfaced to /v1 clients, and explicit structured message shaping for message/role/finish_reason parity. Backwards-compatible by default; enable detailed logprobs via compat flag.
description: Motivation: customers relying on OpenAI /v1/chat.completions expect stable streaming frames, clear semantics for stop tokens when function/tool calling is in play, and access to per-token logprobs for scoring and reranking. This PR closes multiple incompat gaps by 1) making the streaming frame emitter deterministic across retries and batching boundaries with a small ACK/sequence header, 2) changing stop enforcement to be cooperative with tool calls so that an immediate stop does not silently drop an in-flight function call, 3) adding an opt-in per-token logprobs path that maps to the choices[].logprobs shape expected by OpenAI clients, and 4) shaping the final emitted message objects to match /v1/chat.completions message/role/finish_reason fields reliably across streaming and non-streaming flows. Implementation notes: streaming frames use a new frame_writer package with id/seq/partial flags to avoid interleaving on concurrent streams; compatibility middleware maps Redwood internal 'tool_invocation' states to OpenAI "finish_reason":"function_call" and ensures the stop token handler waits for safe handoff or returns a structured partial result with finish_reason 'stop' preserved. Per-token logprobs are produced by a new logprobs encoder behind a feature flag due to memory impact; we expose a `compat.openai.logprobs` flag in the control plane. Tests: added deterministic frame-order unit tests, end-to-end tests for stop+tool handoff, and an integration test surface exercising logprobs sampling paths. Rolling strategy: staged rollout behind feature flag by account; auto-fallback to legacy compat behaviour on flaky streams. Backwards compatibility: default behaviour unchanged; operators can opt in to strict /v1 parity. See related Linear tickets ENG-7421 and ENG-7480.

bd3e90c: implement stop-token cooperative handler with tool handoff protocol
e4f12b7: add logprobs encoder and compat mapping to choices[].logprobs
a9d8c33: message shaping middleware for /v1/chat.completions output

review_comments: Marc Chen: Requested explicit ordering guarantees and suggested an ACK header on frames to avoid client-side reassembly issues.
Lydia Gómez: Asked for a test that simulates a stop arriving while a tool call is mid-flight; noted the importance of returning a partial result rather than dropping tool output.
Ravi Singh: Flagged memory/regressions from emitting full per-token logprobs on large sequences; asked for feature flag and account-level opt-in.

Author (Aisha): Addressed comments by adding frame ACKs, implementing a safe handoff that returns a structured partial result when appropriate, and gating logprobs behind compat.openai.logprobs; responded with benchmarks and updated tests.
ci_checks: e2e: flaky on first run (race in stream framing) then fixed; all subsequent runs pass
perf: <1% median latency regression in worst-case due to added coordination, covered by docs and opt-in guidance
notes_for_ops: Flag: compat.openai.logprobs=false by default; enable per-account via control plane to avoid memory spikes.
Rolling upgrade: enable on 5% of traffic for 24h, monitor stream-error-rate and avg token latency.
Fallback: if stream reassembly errors exceed threshold, platform will revert to legacy frame emitter for affected accounts.
Telemetry: new metrics stream.frame.ack_latency and compat.stop.handoff_count added to console dashboards.
test_plan: Unit: deterministic frame ordering and ACK semantics (TSIM harness).
Integration: stop token + tool invocation handoff with mocked tool endpoints.
E2E: full streaming session from /v1/chat.completions client (Python sdk) verifying choices[].logprobs shape when flag enabled.
Load: 10k concurrent streams to verify frame writer scales and does not degrade KV cache hit rates.
